user_goal: Execute research command 1 as the current Trigger-1 Global J-Space research cycle: context ingestion, hypothesis/counterhypothesis formation, external research, evidence fusion, and selection of the two highest-information executable tests.

trigger1_repo_contract.evidence_rule: Hosted text prompting is not direct vector steering; positive steering requires actual intervention consumption plus directional holdout effect and matched controls.

external_research.finding: Activation Addition demonstrates inference-time residual-stream steering from activation-difference vectors and supports genuine internal intervention as a distinct mechanism from prompting.
Contrastive Activation Addition demonstrates behavior steering with positive/negative coefficients and motivates sign-paired directional controls.
Steering vectors can be high-variance and sometimes reverse the desired effect; coherent activation-difference geometry predicts reliability.
Best steering layers can vary by instance; fixed global layer choices can lose substantial benefit, strengthening the need for calibration/holdout separation.
pyvene provides executable getter/setter intervention hooks and causal intervention tooling on PyTorch models, demonstrating a practical local intervention surface.
Qwen3-0.6B is Qwen3ForCausalLM with hidden_size=1024 and 28 layers.
TransformerLens currently lists Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B as a supported model.
Qwen3.5-0.8B is exactly 0.8B-class with hidden_size=1024 and 24 layers, but uses a hybrid repeated linear-attention/Gated-DeltaNet plus full-attention layout.

runtime_surface.result: Use a local open-weight intervention-capable surface for causal credit. FREE hosted chat/text APIs may produce research proposals but cannot by themselves prove hidden-state/vector consumption.

adapter_identity.result: Bind JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 to exact model/checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build and layer-width before any intervention. Hidden width 1024 is compatible at the gross dimensional level for both Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3.5-0.8B, but architecture-specific semantics are not transferable by width alone.

layer_localization.result: Select layer/range only on a calibration split and freeze before holdout. Literature does not justify one universal layer.

gain_calibration.result: Sweep signed alpha on calibration only; freeze before holdout. Reject improvements that track perturbation magnitude without directional specificity.

sign_flip_control.result: +VECTOR must outperform SIGN_FLIP directionally on matched seeds; otherwise generic perturbation or sampling variance remains plausible.

null_control.result: Exact zero-vector intervention must remain near baseline; substantial NULL drift invalidates causal attribution.

orthogonal_control.result: Same-norm orthogonal control rejects generic activation-energy explanations.

permuted_control.result: Same-norm coordinate permutation rejects coordinate-insensitive/norm-only effects.

seed_holdout_reproduction.result: Frozen layer/gain must reproduce directional effect on disjoint prompts/seeds; report variance and strongest counterexample, not only mean uplift.

receipt_chain_and_delta_forge.result: Forge-ready evidence must bind exact consumed intervention identity through model invocation and downstream receipt chain; process success or textual agreement is insufficient.

primary_hypothesis.statement: A first causal J-Space steering discriminator is more likely to succeed and be interpretable on Qwen3-0.6B than on Qwen3.5-0.8B because Qwen3-0.6B has a conventional Qwen3 transformer stack and existing TransformerLens support, while Qwen3.5-0.8B introduces a hybrid DeltaNet/full-attention architecture that adds intervention-site ambiguity.
primary_hypothesis.prediction: A bounded local residual-stream intervention harness can establish consumed-vector identity and matched-control directional effects on Qwen3-0.6B with less adapter/backend work than Qwen3.5-0.8B.
primary_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Qwen3.5-0.8B generic Hugging Face hidden-state hooks are already sufficient, so its hybrid architecture does not materially increase causal-intervention complexity and exact 0.8B alignment is worth targeting first.
primary_hypothesis.falsifier: If an exact Qwen3.5-0.8B local hook consumes a bound 1024-d control vector at a named residual location, passes NULL/sign/orthogonal/permuted controls, and reaches stable holdout effect with equal or less implementation complexity than Qwen3-0.6B, reject H1.

secondary_hypothesis.statement: A single global J-Space steering vector may fail on some behaviors because the target representation is prompt-dependent or multi-dimensional rather than one coherent direction.
secondary_hypothesis.prediction: Low within-class direction coherence will correlate with high variance or sign reversals on holdout.
secondary_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: The chosen J-Space feature is sufficiently linear and coherent that one fixed direction generalizes across prompts and seeds.
secondary_hypothesis.falsifier: High direction coherence plus reproducible fixed-vector holdout effect across disjoint prompt families weakens the multi-direction/subspace hypothesis.

selected_two_tests_for_next_cycle.pass_condition: Executor-side consumed-vector receipt exists; NULL remains baseline-like; +VECTOR shows reproducible directional holdout effect larger than SIGN_FLIP/orthogonal/permuted controls without severe off-target collapse.

selected_two_tests_for_next_cycle.credit_if_pass: MODEL_SPECIFIC_08B_ADAPTER_COMPONENT_ONLY; no transfer of Qwen3-0.6B causal credit by analogy.
